messages:
Anna (SRE): Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — I consolidated the action list and want explicit owners + timelines so these don't slip into the spiral. TL;DR: routing quirks, backups validation, runbook gaps, game-day cadence.

Devon (Eng-Infra): thanks, Anna. can you paste the condensed list here? i can own the routing items.

Anna (SRE): pasted below. trying to keep each item <=1 line. please reply with: assigned owner, ETA, and blocker if any.

Anna (SRE): 1) Multi-region BGP failover play: verify region-weight routing policy + automated fallback tests.
Anna (SRE): 2) Snapshot & restore verification: automate daily incremental restore into a staging cluster (check for drift).

Anna (SRE): 3) Restore runbook gaps: add explicit post-restore KV cache priming step + traffic-shift checklist.

Anna (SRE): 4) Game-day cadence: quarterly warm-standby failover drill schedule + invite list and war-room template.

Anna (SRE): 5) Incident pattern tracker: surface recurring errors to the evals team (e.g., routing thundering, snapshot timeouts).

Marta (Platform PM): i'll shepherd the game-day cadence + war-room template. propose first drill w/in 6 weeks.

Sahil (Oncall): i'll pick up snapshot & restore verification. ETA 3 weeks to get the daily restores running in staging, then 1 week of stability checks. blockers: need additional staging GPUs and a storage restore quota increase.

Lee (SRE): i can own the runbook gaps. i already have a draft for KV priming from last drill — will convert to explicit steps + checkboxes. ETA 10 days.

Devon (Eng-Infra): i'll take multi-region BGP policy validation. ETA 2 weeks for canary tests and automated fallback harness. blocker: need a test prefix for the EU region we can abuse without impacting prod.

Marta (Platform PM): incident pattern tracker — i'll work with Anna to define the recurring-error taxonomy and hand off to research/evangelism. ETA 2 sprints.

Anna (SRE): perfect. assigning per replies: Devon (routing) 2w, Sahil (snapshots) 3w + infra quota, Lee (runbook) 10d, Marta (cadence + tracker) 2sprints.

Anna (SRE): small ops notes: when you make changes, tag PR with `postmortem/dr-2026-03` and add the following metadata to the PR body: owner, ETA, rollback plan, and test plan.

Devon (Eng-Infra): noted. I'll open a WIP PR and link the canary test harness. sample test command we plan to run on the canary:

```
# simulate region outage and validate routing fallback
./canary-run --target eu-west-1 --fail-region primary --validate http-200 --max-latency 500ms
```

Sahil (Oncall): for snapshot restores i'll add a cron job in staging:

```
# daily restore at 02:00 UTC
0 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/perform-restore --snapshot latest --cluster staging --notify onfail
```

Sahil (Oncall): also requesting @devops for storage quota bump. can someone escalate?

Marta (Platform PM): tagging @DevOps in the follow-up doc and the war-room invite. i'll draft the calendar invite and include the playbook link.

Anna (SRE): OpsBot: create recurring task for quarterly game-day drills and assign tentative owners.

OpsBot: Created task #DR-2026-Q1-DRILL, recurrence: quarterly, owners: Marta/Anna/Lee. Next occurrence: 2026-04-15.

Lee (SRE): quick question: for the KV priming step, do we want a traffic-replay or synthetic warmup? leaning synthetic to avoid data leakage.

Anna (SRE): synthetic warmup + QA validation. add a TTL-check to ensure primed keys expire after 48h in staging.

Devon (Eng-Infra): blocker follow-up: created test prefix <TEST-EU-ROUTE> and added ACLs. PR coming. ETA for fence-to-prod safety: 48h.

Sahil (Oncall): storage quota request ticket: #INC-8421. pinging infra-ops.

Marta (Platform PM): calendar invite draft shared: "DR Game Day — warm standby drill". included runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-restore-v2 — pls review.

Anna (SRE): for tracking, i've added a short spreadsheet with columns: item, owner, ETA, blocker, status, PR/issue link. linking here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1X-DR-FOLLOWUP (internal access). update rows when you open PRs/tickets.

Devon (Eng-Infra): PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/PR-3987 — routing canary harness (WIP). assigned reviewers: Lee, Anna.

Lee (SRE): reviewing now. quick nit: include a --dry-run flag for the canary harness.

Sahil (Oncall): snapshot restore job created in staging, ran 1st test, encountered timeout on object-store read (30s). added note in sheet + ticket #INC-8422.

Anna (SRE): good catch. Sahil, list the top 3 failure modes in the ticket. we'll triage tomorrow 10:30am PT.

Marta (Platform PM): cadence milestone: first drill target 2026-04-15, pre-checks due 2026-04-01. everyone confirm by EOD Friday?

Devon (Eng-Infra): confirmed.

Lee (SRE): confirmed.

Sahil (Oncall): confirmed pending quota.

Anna (SRE): action: i will run weekly 1-line check-ins in #incidents-summary until all items closed.

OpsBot: Reminder set: weekly check-in message in #incidents-summary every Mon 09:00 UTC.

Anna (SRE): thanks all — if anything blocks, flag in the sheet and ping me directly. we'll re-open this thread for any escalations. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Thread archived to incident-tracker with tag `dr-followup`.
